# GRALWEBS — ENGINEERING THE IMPOSSIBLE

## Identity

Engineering the Impossible is an interactive technical web
experience created as a demonstration project by GralWebs Solutions.

GralWebs Solutions specializes in premium custom web development,
interactive experiences, modern interfaces and bespoke digital
solutions.

Official website:
https://jet-mecanic.vercel.app/

## Project

Engineering the Impossible is an interactive aerospace-engineering
visualization experience.

The experience presents a 3D jet engine interface designed to
explore engine architecture, components, mechanical systems and
technical visualization through scroll-driven interaction.

## Technology

The experience uses technologies including:

- HTML5
- CSS3
- JavaScript
- Three.js
- GSAP
- WebGL
- GLB / glTF 3D assets
- Responsive web design

## Interactive Features

- Interactive 3D engine visualization
- Scroll-driven storytelling
- Animated engine components
- Exploded-view visualization
- Technical HUD interface
- Responsive interface
- Cinematic transitions
- Engineering-inspired visual design

## Purpose

The project is a technical demonstration and portfolio experience
showcasing GralWebs Solutions' ability to design and develop
premium interactive web experiences.
